messages:
ani: Kicking off a check-in for the 'service trellis' refactor — thinking out loud about the migration path and rollback lifeboats. Low-risk first slice?

carl: +1 to iterative slices. I think starting with the read-only enrichment path is safest (no writes, small traffic). :thumbsup:

maria: Agree. Also we should define a compatibility adapter for the old gateway so clients don't see churn. Minimal facade to translate requests -> new trellis RPC.

leo: Quick note: cache ownership is the tricky bit. If we split services by facet, who owns the KV prefix? We need a single cache owner per keyspace or strong invalidation hooks.

ani: Proposal: keep existing cache as a 'shared cache' for the first two slices, then move ownership in slice 3. That gets us perf parity while we verify correctness.

carl: Sounds good. Add a feature flag so we can flip between shared vs local cache per slice.

maria: For the facade, here's a tiny shim example we'd use:```js
// pseudo-handler
async function handle(req) {
  if (featureFlag('trellis_v1')) return proxyToTrellis(req)
  return legacyHandler(req)
}
```
This keeps routing deterministic and lets us A/B.

leo: How do we plan to route tenant traffic? By tenant-id header -> sticky to old path until cutover? Or per-route canary?

ani: Start tenant-by-tenant for high-risk customers, and route 5% random traffic from new customers as a canary. After 24h SLO checks, increase to 25%, then full.

ops-bot: deploy:trellis-shim v0.1 deployed to staging (build 3821) :rocket:

carl: Add metrics checklist: 1) request latency p50/p95, 2) error rate by route, 3) cache hit ratio per keyspace, 4) end-to-end tail latency (client->response). We'll gate further rollout on those.

maria: Migration DB writes — we'll dual-write for a grace period and add a background reconciliation job. Reconcile job should be idempotent and rate-limited.

leo: Reconcile job idea: incremental cursor per partition, checkpointed in durable store. If we fail, resume from checkpoint. Keep ops-runbook steps for resume.

ani: Runbook sketch: 1) pause canary, 2) switch calls to legacy, 3) inspect reconcile progress and logs, 4) roll back feature flag. Keep approval from platform on hand.

carl: Timeline suggestion: 2-week spike to harden adapter + cache flag, then 1-week staged rollout. Leaves enough time for perf/alerts tuning.

maria: Side concern: policy plane dependencies. The trellis services need a lightweight policy client; don't pull the full policy-service dependency initially — use a read-only policy cache.

leo: Noted. Also we should add a smoke test harness that can be run by CI against staging trellis slices. Minimal tests: auth, enrichment correctness, cache behavior.

ani: Action items: Carl -> feature flag impl + metrics hooks; Maria -> adapter shim + dual-write plan; Leo -> reconcile job sketch + runbook; Ani -> schedule spike + sync with platform. I'll create a follow-up thread with concrete RFC artifacts. :wave:

carl: I'll start a branch and tag you all. :eyes:

maria: Uploading adapter prototype to the infra repo later today.

ops-bot: note: incident-playbook template attached: /playbooks/trellis-cutover.md

ani: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the spike. :thumbsup:
